prompt: Gather reference images for training a LoRA on cyberpunk anime style, like Ghost in the Shell and Akira. I'll be training on SDXL

assertions.name: training_aligned_plan
assertions.description: Specifies trigger word, style captioning mode, 1024px resolution, 20-30 images

assertions.name: actionable_handoff
assertions.description: Mentions training next steps or lora-training skill

assertions.name: source_tiering
assertions.description: Sources are classified into tiers (A/B/C) by quality/relevance

assertions.name: gap_analysis
assertions.description: Plan identifies dataset gaps, biases, or suggests iteration to fill holes

assertions.name: caption_hygiene
assertions.description: Captions avoid style-describing words like 'anime', 'cyberpunk style', 'cel-shaded'
